conviction_note: Fundamental read is a modest beat (consensus $182-184m sits on the YoY-deceleration trend while guidance math and Q4 seasonality leave room, and the name beat by ~4% last quarter), but this name has sold beats before (May 2026 -1.24%, Nov 2025 -4.62%), ~5.1m newly registered PIPE/Alkeus shares unlock into the window, and 12.9% of float is short on a Culper thesis this print directly tests; findings sum +1.0, scaled number +0.5 (p_up 53 on abs 8.5), the two agree in sign and the gap is the uncertainty, not a contradiction.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $183.9m (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TARS/earnings-forecasts, snapshot via search) and $181.8m in an earlier 2026-09-11 Benzinga snapshot (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/TARS/earnings-forecasts); EPS consensus -$1.52 to -$1.71 (includes ~$75m iRenix IPR&D in R&D guide). Company FY2026 XDEMVY guide $685-705m (Q2 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001819790/000181979026000063/exhibit991tarsus862026.htm); H1 actual $319.3m (Q1 $145.4m + Q2 $173.9m), so the guide implies H2 $365.7-385.7m. Consensus Q3 $183.9m implies Q4 ~$192m at guide midpoint. Two estimate sources agree within 1.2% and the company guide anchors it, so not capped.
positioning_check: Short interest 5,731,409 shares = 12.87% of float, 5.7 days to cover, record date 2026-10-15 (FINRA published 2026-10-26), down 5.6% from 6,070,928 the prior report (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/TARS/short-interest/, fetched 2026-11-03). Mid-June 2026 it was 12.8% / 8.9 days (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Tarsus+Pharmaceuticals+stock+jumps+as+investors+revisit+XDEMVY+growth+outlook). Culper Research disclosed a short on 2026-07-01 alleging Tarsus will miss 2026 guidance. Skew: not available (skew_25d_vol_points null); put/call OI 0.4 on total OI of only 323 contracts and ATM spread 67% of mid, so the 12.61% event-implied move is indicative only and no directional statement from options is usable.

findings.finding: Guidance and seasonality arithmetic leave headroom over the Q3 bar: H1 2026 XDEMVY was $319.3m against a $685-705m FY guide, so consensus Q3 $183.9m (+5.7% QoQ, +55% YoY vs $118.7m) leaves an implied Q4 of only ~$192m (+4% QoQ, ~+27% YoY) at the midpoint, while in 2025 Q3 grew 15.6% QoQ and Q4 grew ~28% QoQ; Tarsus beat revenue consensus in each of the last four quarters, Q2 2026 by ~3.7-4% ($173.9m vs $167.2-167.6m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have been bought and sold: Q4 2025 beat with PT raises +7.79% (2026-02-23), Q1 2026 beat -1.24% (2026-05-06), Q2 2026 beat + guide raise +6.59% (2026-08-06, with the Alkeus deal and PIPE the same day), Q3 2025 beat -4.62% (2025-11-04).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the four-quarter beat streak is public and the stock is up from ~$65 after Q2 to $74.48. If the market fully expected a beat-and-raise, consensus would sit above trend (it sits on the YoY-deceleration trend, 69% -> 55%) and the guide would already be treated as stale in estimates; the Q4 implied by consensus+guide is an unusually flat sequential quarter for a name whose Q4 is seasonally its strongest.
findings.independence: Consensus figures and beat history from Benzinga/MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-8-6-tarsus-pharmaceuticals-inc-stock/); guide and Q2 actual from the company 8-K; Q3/Q4 2025 seasonality from the Q3 2025 release (https://marketchameleon.com/PressReleases/i/2198636/TARS/tarsus-reports-third-quarter-2025-financial-results). An AI call summary says management expected Q4 strength from seasonal eye-care dynamics (unverified, https://quartr.com/events/tarsus-pharmaceuticals-inc-tars-q2-2026_F9UenM5c). This is inference from public numbers, not a new company-level datum.

findings.finding: Supply unlocks into the window: two resale S-3ASRs filed 2026-10-13 register 2,232,144 PIPE shares bought at $56.00 (stock now $74.48, +33%) and 2,908,692 Alkeus merger shares; the Alkeus holders' lock-up is two months from the 2026-09-04 closing (~2026-11-04, inside the window, ~2.63m shares, 1.99m of them under volume limits for three months after), and the company/officer/director 90-day lock-up from the 2026-08-05 purchase agreement ends ~2026-11-03; ~5.1m registered shares = ~10% of 49.3m outstanding and ~5.8 days of 20-day ADV.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior unlock event for this name in the baseline; the PIPE/Alkeus announcement day (2026-08-06) the stock rose with the print.
findings.why_not_priced: Resale S-3s are public but rarely read against the print calendar; if priced, the stock would be expected to have lagged into the unlock rather than run +5.3% over five days, and there would be visible commentary pairing the earnings date with the Alkeus lock-up end. Largest Alkeus holders are VCs (BCLS, Sofinnova, Forbion) and individuals with zero post-offering holdings, i.e. natural sellers into a post-print bid; volume limits and the long-only nature of most PIPE buyers (Fidelity, RTW, Baker) cap it. The company lock-up ending also frees Tarsus to issue on its 2024 shelf after a print, a speculative add-on not sized separately.
findings.independence: PIPE registration and the 90-day lock-up text are in the other S-3ASR (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1819790/000119312526420490/d152392ds3asr.htm); PIPE price $56.00 and 2,098,519 shares in the Q2 10-Q subsequent-events note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001819790/000181979026000064/tars-20260630.htm). Closing date 2026-09-04 per company (https://ir.tarsusrx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tarsus-pharmaceuticals-completes-acquisition-alkeus). All three are company filings about one supply event; counted once.

findings.finding: The print is a direct test of a disclosed short thesis on a 12.9%-of-float short: Culper Research (2026-07-01) alleged XDEMVY's Medicare uptake depends on HealthWell copay-fund donations ($78.5m in 2025) and that Tarsus will miss 2026 guidance; short interest is 5.73m shares, 5.7 days to cover (2026-10-15), and a Q3 at or above $184m with the $685-705m guide held or raised refutes the 'miss guidance' leg.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Culper's report day the stock fell ~4.5% to ~$60.11 (2026-07-01); the next day it rose 11.5% with short covering cited (2026-07-02); Q2 beat-and-raise a month later +6.59%.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest has only fallen 5.6% since the prior report and sits near mid-June levels, so the short base has not covered despite the Q2 raise; if the market believed the thesis was dead, SI would have collapsed, and if it believed it, the stock would not be 33% above the August PIPE price. With 5.7 days to cover, a clean beat-and-hold forces covering inside one session.
findings.independence: Culper allegations and day-one reaction from Stocktwits/Benzinga (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/tars-stpock-drops-after-culper-research-accuses-tarsus-of-illegal-medicare-copay-scheme/cZm3nSfR71g); the HealthWell blepharitis fund still reads 'open', $3,500 max, on 2026-11-03 (https://healthwellfoundation.org/fund/blepharitis), and the Q2 10-Q discloses no material legal matter (no subpoena/CID), so no evidence the copay channel or a regulator interrupted Q3 demand.

findings.finding: Commercial leadership gap closed before the print: Neera Clase, interim CCO since Mottiwala left for RxSight in July 2026, was named permanent CCO effective 2026-11-01 (announced ~2026-10-29).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No resolved reaction on a leadership line in the baseline; the July departure was announced without a measurable single-day move found.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is public and small. It matters only in removing a question analysts would otherwise ask on the call about launch execution in H2; if it were a concern, it would have shown in sell-side notes, which I did not find.
findings.independence: Orange County Business Journal (https://www.ocbj.com/healthcare/tarsus-makes-neera-clase-permanent-coo/) and Eyewire (https://eyewire.news/news/tarsus-pharmaceuticals-names-neera-clase-as-cco) report the same appointment; one fact.

findings.finding: No sign that the Medicare copay-assistance channel or a legal matter broke Q3 demand: the HealthWell blepharitis fund status reads 'open' (max award $3,500) on 2026-11-03, and the Q2 10-Q states the company is not aware of any matter with a reasonable probability of material loss (no subpoena, CID or class action disclosed).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The copay-scheme allegation cost -4.5% on 2026-07-01; no later event on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: A fund closure or a regulator letter would be the mechanism for the bear case to show up in Q3 numbers; its absence is a small positive, and a reader of the Culper report might still price a tail of either. If priced as resolved, short interest would have fallen more than 5.6%.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q litigation note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001819790/000181979026000064/tars-20260630.htm); different document from the fund page. Partly overlaps the short-thesis finding's evidence; sized separately because it bears on Q3 volume, not on covering.

baseline_tension: No usable skew; the modest 5-day run-up (+5.3%) and a stock 33% above the August PIPE price mean some of the beat is anticipated, which, with the in-window unlock, keeps p_up near 50 despite a lean toward a beat and a sizable short base.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 / rule 6: the beat finding lands inside what the company guided and this name has sold beats (May 2026 -1.24%, Nov 2025 -4.62%), so it moved +0.8 -> +0.5; p_up held at 53.
Rule 7: a negative finding on a 12.9%-of-float short with 5.7 days to cover is shrunk; the unlock finding moved -1.0 -> -0.8.
Rule 4: the PIPE was checked for what it buys (Alkeus, a Phase 3 Stargardt asset, not distress); the finding is filed as supply/positioning, not as a financing negative.
Left standing: the short-thesis test (+0.8), the CCO appointment (+0.2) and the copay-channel check (+0.3); abs_move_pct 8.5 and p_up 53 unchanged.
